gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-readex-pro: Nulshock stretches its bold, technical capitals wide, drawn with a steady, unshaded outline. Readex Pro follows in a plain sans, its weight unvarying from word to word, so long reading stays smooth.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-ruda: Technical and bold, Nulshock stretches wide across the top. Ruda's sans-serif body has a sizable x-height and a wire-like monoline skeleton, so extended reading feels light, open and easy on a screen.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-saira: Saira reads with rounded letters reaching high toward the top line and a visible gap in every s. Nulshock's constant-width pen line above it keeps a long read moving.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-schibsted-grotesk: A tube-like, constant-width stroke defines Nulshock. Schibsted Grotesk follows in a plain sans with big open e and a shapes, and terminals that never close in, so paragraphs read approachably.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-sen: Nulshock stretches wide, technical and bold. Sen, a plain sans built tall with one constant line tracing each letter, sits beneath it, so the page reads modern and tidy.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-sofia-sans: Modern and bold in spirit, Nulshock spreads wide. Sofia Sans, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation and tall stencil-like lowercase, feels like its quieter, upright cousin standing beside it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Clean and contemporary, Sofia Sans Semi Condensed has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and a big visible entrance into each curve. Beside Nulshock's wide, technical outline, it feels strikingly tidy.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-stack-sans-headli: Stack Sans Headline reads crisp, with wide gaps and a deep middle band over a monoline skeleton. Nulshock's wide lettering sits above it; size the sans-serif body up a little.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-yaldevi: Nulshock's strokes look traced with a marker, stretched wide and technical. Yaldevi's outsized lowercase and clearly opened e then take over beneath it as a sans.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-syncopate: Round, parenthesis-like forms give Oldtimer a stately look. Syncopate's plain sans spacing, steady like a technical pen, makes the pair clearly composed: grand above, orderly below.
